severity: quarantined + repaired mid-run (the R412 v2 gate-field-defect precedent: original bytes preserved, fix disclosed, bounded re-attempt)
description: lane_c_queries() split the ga1b gate.frontier_domains string by comma WITHOUT filtering epistemic-state markers. 7 of the 13 ga1b rungs record frontier_domains as the literal string 'UNKNOWN' — an explicit NOT-DETERMINED state (Art. XXV), never a search domain. The lane C construction used 'UNKNOWN' as a literal search term, producing queries like 'UNKNOWN device switching energy measured performance improvement' — noise injected into provider queries.

affected_executed_query.query: UNKNOWN device switching energy measured performance improvement
affected_executed_query.disposition: QUARANTINED — the pool file is deleted from the run in the same change that ships the fix; the full original bytes remain recoverable in git history (this incident artifact records the query, the record ids, and the disposition; no downstream stage consumed the file — the benchmark evaluator had not yet run)

root_cause: the ga1b extraction recorded frontier_domains='UNKNOWN' for rungs where the proposer could not name a domain (an honest epistemic state); lane_c_queries treated the field as always-domain-bearing without a validity filter
fix: lane_c_queries() now filters domain tokens against a closed invalid-token set (unknown, not stated, n/a, none, unspecified, empty) — a rung with no VALID recorded frontier domain emits ZERO lane C queries and the miss is RECORDED (LANE_C_NO_VALID_FRONTIER_DOMAIN — Art. XXV: unknown stays unknown, never fabricated into a search term)
reseal: the lane plan sha256 changes; the v3 preregistration is REBUILT (all other pins unchanged) BEFORE the lane run resumes; no LLM call has been made at any point in this incident window (the lane stage is fabric retrieval only); completed UNPOLLUTED lane queries keep their committed bytes (their query strings are unchanged in the new plan and are skipped by content-keyed resumption)
